findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "eval" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_testing_guidelines, run_pr_gate_pipeline, generate_test_cases, web_security_audit, mcp_server_evaluate, test_skill, rate_tool, screen_text, model_catalogue · Private data: run_pr_gate_pipeline, web_security_audit, test_skill, generate_ci_workflow, rate_tool, screen_text, check_api_contract, model_catalogue · Public sink: generate_test_cases, screen_text · Destructive: get_testing_guidelines, run_pr_gate_pipeline, generate_test_cases, analyze_test_results, run_eval_contract, agent_checkout_eval, test_skill, generate_ci_workflow, evaluate_llm_output, evaluate_agent_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_testing_guidelines, run_pr_gate_pipeline, generate_test_cases, web_security_audit, mcp_server_evaluate, test_skill, rate_tool, screen_text, model_catalogue · Private data: run_pr_gate_pipeline, web_security_audit, test_skill, generate_ci_workflow, rate_tool, screen_text, check_api_contract, model_catalogue · Public sink: generate_test_cases, screen_text · Destructive: get_testing_guidelines, run_pr_gate_pipeline, generate_test_cases, analyze_test_results, run_eval_contract, agent_checkout_eval, test_skill, generate_ci_workflow, evaluate_llm_output, evaluate_agent_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_test_cases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
